title: Hunts FH-020U: Produce held Hunt claims for opted-in staff review
detail: Requires FH-049T and FH-020S. In hunt_claim_apply, allow an opted-in mission policy to record one needs_review claim for a qualifying assurance failure. Use the current mission-to-placement binding as the authority for the venue. Keep the default assurance refusal side-effect-free. A held claim creates no progress, reward, or credit outbox event. Prove a repeated command does not create another held row and that authorized existing review can resume it exactly once. Register and release through the serial HYG-217 process. Review and appeal UI follow the separate staff authorization ruling. Before release, record pgTAP and exact-head workflow_dispatch db-tests, real API acceptance, the approved apply sequence, and Frequency Community ledger parity.
